international_aviation.headline_en: SpiceJet Agrees to Lease 20 Aircraft to Expand Fleet Ahead of Winter Schedule
international_aviation.summary_en: SpiceJet has agreed to lease 20 Boeing and Airbus aircraft to support winter operations.

sources.name: AeroTime — SpiceJet plans to nearly triple active fleet with deal for…
Aerospace Global News — SpiceJet lines up 20 leased aircraft as it rebuilds fleet f…

new_information: SpiceJet finalized agreements with three aircraft operators to lease 20 aircraft under wet and damp leases.
The lease deal includes 15 Boeing aircraft and five Airbus aircraft scheduled to arrive between mid-October and mid-November 2026.
The leased Airbus fleet will include higher-capacity Airbus A321 aircraft.
SpiceJet currently operates 11 aircraft and aims to increase its operational fleet to about 31 aircraft to operate roughly 200 daily flights during the winter schedule.
